violation_type.title: Discipline - Use Positive Methods of Discipline and Guidance (26 TAC §747.2703(4))
violation_type.short_title: Discipline - Use Positive Methods of Discipline and Guidance
violation_type.typical_finding: Information obtained throughout the investigation shows that a caregiver used physical contact as a method of discipline rather than using positive guidance techniques that encourage the child's self-esteem, self-control, and self-direction.

finding_variants.text: Information obtained throughout the investigation shows that a caregiver used physical contact as a method of discipline rather than using positive guidance techniques that encourage the child's self-esteem, self-control, and self-direction.
Text messages received show confirmation of biting a child in an effort to show the child biting is not ok.
A caregiver was observed tapping a child's leg and not using positive methods of discipline.
